meta.title: Chain Reaction of the Electron Avalanche
meta.description: From light to darkness, from prosperity to ruin, from joy to sorrow, from life to death. Mass has always been conserved; it has simply taken a different form in your eyes.

units.rawText: As the dizziness fades away, I once again feel like I'm standing on terra firma.
units.displayText: As the dizziness fades away, I once again feel like I'm standing on terra firma.

spans.text: As the dizziness fades away, I once again feel like I'm standing on terra firma.

units.rawText: However, I sense something is amiss even before my vision fully recovers.
units.displayText: However, I sense something is amiss even before my vision fully recovers.

spans.text: However, I sense something is amiss even before my vision fully recovers.

units.rawText: Hnnnngggg...!
units.displayText: Hnnnngggg...!

spans.text: Hnnnngggg...!

units.rawText: It is a pain like being plunged into the depths of Hell.
units.displayText: It is a pain like being plunged into the depths of Hell.

spans.text: It is a pain like being plunged into the depths of Hell.

units.rawText: Hot air blasts me in the face and my throat feels like it's being seared by a scorching flame.
units.displayText: Hot air blasts me in the face and my throat feels like it's being seared by a scorching flame.

spans.text: Hot air blasts me in the face and my throat feels like it's being seared by a scorching flame.

units.rawText: The breathing that normally sustains life is now a torturous ideal, mercilessly ripping away what moisture remains within my body.
units.displayText: The breathing that normally sustains life is now a torturous ideal, mercilessly ripping away what moisture remains within my body.

spans.text: The breathing that normally sustains life is now a torturous ideal, mercilessly ripping away what moisture remains within my body.

units.rawText: I slowly open my eyes, and my fear and discomfort at the unknown are instantly replaced by shock at what I see before me.
units.displayText: I slowly open my eyes, and my fear and discomfort at the unknown are instantly replaced by shock at what I see before me.

spans.text: I slowly open my eyes, and my fear and discomfort at the unknown are instantly replaced by shock at what I see before me.

units.rawText: What... is this...
units.displayText: What... is this...

spans.text: What... is this...

units.rawText: The world before me is an endless sea of flames.
units.displayText: The world before me is an endless sea of flames.

spans.text: The world before me is an endless sea of flames.

units.rawText: All I see are scorched ruins, out to the limits of my vision.
units.displayText: All I see are scorched ruins, out to the limits of my vision.

spans.text: All I see are scorched ruins, out to the limits of my vision.

units.rawText: In the distance, thick smoke rises into the air and blots out the sun. For a moment I'm unsure if this is day or night.
units.displayText: In the distance, thick smoke rises into the air and blots out the sun. For a moment I'm unsure if this is day or night.

spans.text: In the distance, thick smoke rises into the air and blots out the sun. For a moment I'm unsure if this is day or night.

units.rawText: ...Mayuri?
units.displayText: ...Mayuri?

spans.text: ...Mayuri?

units.rawText: Kurisu? Faris? Comrade?
units.displayText: Kurisu? Faris? Comrade?

spans.text: Kurisu? Faris? Comrade?

units.rawText: The bustling cafe from before is gone, replaced by a solitary, dead silence around me.
units.displayText: The bustling cafe from before is gone, replaced by a solitary, dead silence around me.

spans.text: The bustling cafe from before is gone, replaced by a solitary, dead silence around me.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hssss—</color>
units.displayText: Hssss—

spans.text: Hssss—

units.rawText: A noise comes from nearby. I instinctively look that way.
units.displayText: A noise comes from nearby. I instinctively look that way.

spans.text: A noise comes from nearby. I instinctively look that way.

units.rawText: Hng!
units.displayText: Hng!

spans.text: Hng!

units.rawText: ...That is not something that should exist in reality.
units.displayText: ...That is not something that should exist in reality.

spans.text: ...That is not something that should exist in reality.

units.rawText: "Monster"—that is the only word which comes to mind. It's a dark purple monster that comes from the darkest depths of light novels and movies. Its tentacles writhe and twitch around itself.
units.displayText: "Monster"—that is the only word which comes to mind. It's a dark purple monster that comes from the darkest depths of light novels and movies. Its tentacles writhe and twitch around itself.

spans.text: "Monster"—that is the only word which comes to mind. It's a dark purple monster that comes from the darkest depths of light novels and movies. Its tentacles writhe and twitch around itself.

units.rawText: As those tentacles pick up the bits of debris around it, the rubble swiftly corrodes and melts away, as though it had never existed.
units.displayText: As those tentacles pick up the bits of debris around it, the rubble swiftly corrodes and melts away, as though it had never existed.

spans.text: As those tentacles pick up the bits of debris around it, the rubble swiftly corrodes and melts away, as though it had never existed.

units.rawText: I can hear scattered screams and gunshots from afar. The sounds scatter in all directions, but in the end, they are drowned out by the roars and growls of the monsters.
units.displayText: I can hear scattered screams and gunshots from afar. The sounds scatter in all directions, but in the end, they are drowned out by the roars and growls of the monsters.

spans.text: I can hear scattered screams and gunshots from afar. The sounds scatter in all directions, but in the end, they are drowned out by the roars and growls of the monsters.

units.rawText: The fear of death has me in its grip. By the time I realize what I've done, I've already ducked behind a pile of rubble, clutching my mouth tightly and mortally afraid of letting the slightest sound escape.
units.displayText: The fear of death has me in its grip. By the time I realize what I've done, I've already ducked behind a pile of rubble, clutching my mouth tightly and mortally afraid of letting the slightest sound escape.

spans.text: The fear of death has me in its grip. By the time I realize what I've done, I've already ducked behind a pile of rubble, clutching my mouth tightly and mortally afraid of letting the slightest sound escape.

units.rawText: It is only when the sounds of the monsters are completely gone that I let go of my mouth and let the beads of cold sweat roll down my forehead.
units.displayText: It is only when the sounds of the monsters are completely gone that I let go of my mouth and let the beads of cold sweat roll down my forehead.

spans.text: It is only when the sounds of the monsters are completely gone that I let go of my mouth and let the beads of cold sweat roll down my forehead.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: W-What the hell was that monster just now...
units.displayText: W-What the hell was that monster just now...

spans.text: W-What the hell was that monster just now...

units.rawText: No way... How could this be...? All I did was send a D-Mail to bring the shipment forward… Why would there be such terrifying monsters...
units.displayText: No way... How could this be...? All I did was send a D-Mail to bring the shipment forward… Why would there be such terrifying monsters...

spans.text: No way... How could this be...? All I did was send a D-Mail to bring the shipment forward… Why would there be such terrifying monsters...

units.rawText: The bad feeling I had is validated.
units.displayText: The bad feeling I had is validated.

spans.text: The bad feeling I had is validated.

units.rawText: I can almost hear mocking laughter in my ear, as though mocking our punishment for toying with the world lines.
units.displayText: I can almost hear mocking laughter in my ear, as though mocking our punishment for toying with the world lines.

spans.text: I can almost hear mocking laughter in my ear, as though mocking our punishment for toying with the world lines.

units.rawText: ...Right, where's everyone else? Did everyone else vanish because I was foolish enough to try and change the past?
units.displayText: ...Right, where's everyone else? Did everyone else vanish because I was foolish enough to try and change the past?

spans.text: ...Right, where's everyone else? Did everyone else vanish because I was foolish enough to try and change the past?

units.rawText: The terrible visage of the monster suddenly appears in my mind.
units.displayText: The terrible visage of the monster suddenly appears in my mind.

spans.text: The terrible visage of the monster suddenly appears in my mind.

units.rawText: They... Don't tell me they...
units.displayText: They... Don't tell me they...

spans.text: They... Don't tell me they...

units.rawText: <size=40>Oi, you there, that mad scientist!</size>
units.displayText: Oi, you there, that mad scientist!

spans.text: Oi, you there, that mad scientist!

units.rawText: I recognize that voice.
units.displayText: I recognize that voice.

spans.text: I recognize that voice.

units.rawText: The long-haired girl with a cool expression on her face stands before me with her arms folded.
units.displayText: The long-haired girl with a cool expression on her face stands before me with her arms folded.

spans.text: The long-haired girl with a cool expression on her face stands before me with her arms folded.

units.rawText: Just seeing her makes me so happy that I'm about to burst into tears.
units.displayText: Just seeing her makes me so happy that I'm about to burst into tears.

spans.text: Just seeing her makes me so happy that I'm about to burst into tears.

units.rawText: Well, we've found you at last. Now let's go...
units.displayText: Well, we've found you at last. Now let's go...

spans.text: Well, we've found you at last. Now let's go...

units.rawText: ...Kurisu!
units.displayText: ...Kurisu!

spans.text: ...Kurisu!

units.rawText: Hey! Don't, don't just go hugging me out of nowhere! I swear I'll report you to the mods you pervert!
units.displayText: Hey! Don't, don't just go hugging me out of nowhere! I swear I'll report you to the mods you pervert!

spans.text: Hey! Don't, don't just go hugging me out of nowhere! I swear I'll report you to the mods you pervert!

units.rawText: ...What a relief. At the very least the girl before me is the same person that I know.
units.displayText: ...What a relief. At the very least the girl before me is the same person that I know.

spans.text: ...What a relief. At the very least the girl before me is the same person that I know.

units.rawText: That said, I can't just focus on rejoicing here.
units.displayText: That said, I can't just focus on rejoicing here.

spans.text: That said, I can't just focus on rejoicing here.

units.rawText: What happened to the Oasis? Where are the others? Are the people from the Lab okay?
units.displayText: What happened to the Oasis? Where are the others? Are the people from the Lab okay?

spans.text: What happened to the Oasis? Where are the others? Are the people from the Lab okay?

units.rawText: That's right, where's Mayuri? What happened to her?
units.displayText: That's right, where's Mayuri? What happened to her?

spans.text: That's right, where's Mayuri? What happened to her?

units.rawText: All the questions in my mind come tumbling out.
units.displayText: All the questions in my mind come tumbling out.

spans.text: All the questions in my mind come tumbling out.

units.rawText: The girl before me is frowning, with a worried look on her face.
units.displayText: The girl before me is frowning, with a worried look on her face.

spans.text: The girl before me is frowning, with a worried look on her face.

units.rawText: ...What are you talking about?
units.displayText: ...What are you talking about?

spans.text: ...What are you talking about?

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: Okabe... Did you come here from another world line?
units.displayText: Okabe... Did you come here from another world line?

spans.text: Okabe... Did you come here from another world line?

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: Upon hearing this, Kurisu's face turns stern.
units.displayText: Upon hearing this, Kurisu's face turns stern.

spans.text: Upon hearing this, Kurisu's face turns stern.

units.rawText: This is a pain...
units.displayText: This is a pain...

spans.text: This is a pain...

units.rawText: ...It's too dangerous here. Let's talk somewhere safer, Okabe.
units.displayText: ...It's too dangerous here. Let's talk somewhere safer, Okabe.

spans.text: ...It's too dangerous here. Let's talk somewhere safer, Okabe.

units.rawText: This way.
units.displayText: This way.

spans.text: This way.

units.rawText: Ah, yeah...
units.displayText: Ah, yeah...

spans.text: Ah, yeah...

units.rawText: I follow Kurisu to a collapsed building.
units.displayText: I follow Kurisu to a collapsed building.

spans.text: I follow Kurisu to a collapsed building.

units.rawText: Dangerous-looking sparks spew from severed wires near my feet every now and then, and the air is unbearably choked with dust and smoke.
units.displayText: Dangerous-looking sparks spew from severed wires near my feet every now and then, and the air is unbearably choked with dust and smoke.

spans.text: Dangerous-looking sparks spew from severed wires near my feet every now and then, and the air is unbearably choked with dust and smoke.

units.rawText: (Coughs) What are we doing in a dilapidated place like this...
units.displayText: (Coughs) What are we doing in a dilapidated place like this...

spans.text: (Coughs) What are we doing in a dilapidated place like this...

units.rawText: ...Finding a relatively safe location is hard enough at a time like this. Don't be picky.
units.displayText: ...Finding a relatively safe location is hard enough at a time like this. Don't be picky.

spans.text: ...Finding a relatively safe location is hard enough at a time like this. Don't be picky.

units.rawText: Okarin!!!
units.displayText: Okarin!!!

spans.text: Okarin!!!

units.rawText: Mayuri! Are you alright?!
units.displayText: Mayuri! Are you alright?!

spans.text: Mayuri! Are you alright?!

units.rawText: Yup, yup! Mayushii is fine~
units.displayText: Yup, yup! Mayushii is fine~

spans.text: Yup, yup! Mayushii is fine~

units.rawText: What about you, Okarin? Are you hurt?
units.displayText: What about you, Okarin? Are you hurt?

spans.text: What about you, Okarin? Are you hurt?

units.rawText: Don't worry, I won't kick the bucket so easily.
units.displayText: Don't worry, I won't kick the bucket so easily.

spans.text: Don't worry, I won't kick the bucket so easily.

units.rawText: Although, where is this place...
units.displayText: Although, where is this place...

spans.text: Although, where
is
this place...

units.rawText: The surroundings are alien, yet strangely familiar.
units.displayText: The surroundings are alien, yet strangely familiar.

spans.text: The surroundings are alien, yet strangely familiar.

units.rawText: It seems it used to be a cafe.
units.displayText: It seems it used to be a cafe.

spans.text: It seems it used to be a cafe.

units.rawText: As for its location... Mayushii thinks it used to be on the Oasis' shopping street?
units.displayText: As for its location... Mayushii thinks it used to be on the Oasis' shopping street?

spans.text: As for its location... Mayushii thinks it used to be on the Oasis' shopping street?

units.rawText: A cafe... Wait, so this is MayQueen+Nyan²?
units.displayText: A cafe... Wait, so this is MayQueen+Nyan²?

spans.text: A cafe... Wait, so this is MayQueen+Nyan²?

units.rawText: ...Hmm?
units.displayText: ...Hmm?

spans.text: ...Hmm?

units.rawText: What are you talking about, Okarin... Is it because too much has happened that your mind is confused...?
units.displayText: What are you talking about, Okarin... Is it because too much has happened that your mind is confused...?

spans.text: What are you talking about, Okarin... Is it because too much has happened that your mind is confused...?

units.rawText: There is a confused look on her face.
units.displayText: There is a confused look on her face.

spans.text: There is a confused look on her face.

units.rawText: ...Oi. Mayuri, this isn't the time for you to be playing dumb.
units.displayText: ...Oi. Mayuri, this isn't the time for you to be playing dumb.

spans.text: ...Oi. Mayuri, this isn't the time for you to be playing dumb.

units.rawText: Where are the others? Daru, Lukako, Faris, my comrade... Where are they all now?
units.displayText: Where are the others? Daru, Lukako, Faris, my comrade... Where are they all now?

spans.text: Where are the others? Daru, Lukako, Faris, my comrade... Where are they all now?

units.rawText: Daru-kun and Luka-kun are somewhere safe. Faris-chan is working with the field dispatch teams.
units.displayText: Daru-kun and Luka-kun are somewhere safe. Faris-chan is working with the field dispatch teams.

spans.text: Daru-kun and Luka-kun are somewhere safe. Faris-chan is working with the field dispatch teams.

units.rawText: But who is this "comrade" of yours, Okarin?
units.displayText: But who is this "comrade" of yours, Okarin?

spans.text: But who is this "comrade" of yours, Okarin?

units.rawText: A strange feeling of foreboding fills our conversation.
units.displayText: A strange feeling of foreboding fills our conversation.

spans.text: A strange feeling of foreboding fills our conversation.

units.rawText: It's <cmdr>! Don't you remember them?
units.displayText: It's {교수}! Don't you remember them?

spans.text: It's
! Don't you remember them?

units.rawText: You should know who that is, right, assistant?
units.displayText: You should know who that is, right, assistant?

spans.text: You should know who that is, right, assistant?

units.rawText: <cmdr> is the Professor of the Oasis! My reliable comrade, who's been helping us out ever since we came to this world!
units.displayText: {교수} is the Professor of the Oasis! My reliable comrade, who's been helping us out ever since we came to this world!

spans.text: is the Professor of the Oasis! My reliable comrade, who's been helping us out ever since we came to this world!

units.displayText: I look at Kurisu, hoping to receive an answer in the affirmative from the girl before me.

spans.text: I look at Kurisu, hoping to receive an answer in the affirmative from the girl before me.

units.rawText: However, she responds with a slow shaking of her head.
units.displayText: However, she responds with a slow shaking of her head.

spans.text: However, she responds with a slow shaking of her head.

units.rawText: Okabe...
units.displayText: Okabe...

spans.text: Okabe...

units.rawText: We never met the Professor you're talking about.
units.displayText: We never met the Professor you're talking about.

spans.text: We never met the Professor you're talking about.

units.rawText: ...Huh?
units.displayText: ...Huh?

spans.text: ...Huh?

units.displayText: Uneasiness and anxiety rapidly fill my heart.

spans.text: Uneasiness and anxiety rapidly fill my heart.

units.rawText: Even I can tell my voice is trembling.
units.displayText: Even I can tell my voice is trembling.

spans.text: Even I can tell my voice is trembling.

units.rawText: What about Persicaria? You should remember Persicaria, right?
units.displayText: What about Persicaria? You should remember Persicaria, right?

spans.text: What about Persicaria? You should remember Persicaria, right?

units.rawText: And what about that green-haired loli!
units.displayText: And what about that green-haired loli!

spans.text: And what about that green-haired loli!

units.rawText: Her name was... It was... That's right! It's Anna! You've seen Anna before, right?
units.displayText: Her name was... It was... That's right! It's Anna! You've seen Anna before, right?

spans.text: Her name was... It was... That's right! It's Anna! You've seen Anna before, right?

units.rawText: Kurisu holds up a hand to stop me.
units.displayText: Kurisu holds up a hand to stop me.

spans.text: Kurisu holds up a hand to stop me.

units.rawText: ...Calm down, Okabe.
units.displayText: ...Calm down, Okabe.

spans.text: ...Calm down, Okabe.

units.rawText: Looks like things in this world line are very different from the previous one...
units.displayText: Looks like things in this world line are very different from the previous one...

spans.text: Looks like things in this world line are very different from the previous one...

units.rawText: Time is tight, Okabe. I'll answer your questions later. Let's start by exchanging information.

units.rawText: Wow~ Faris-chan opened a branch of MayQueen+Nyan² in the Oasis? That's so amazing!

units.rawText: I can't believe the Oasis was so peaceful in the previous world line...
units.displayText: I can't believe the Oasis was so peaceful in the previous world line...

spans.text: I can't believe the Oasis was so peaceful in the previous world line...

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: I still can't believe this hellscape was the Oasis from before... What on earth happened in this world line?
units.displayText: I still can't believe this hellscape was the Oasis from before... What on earth happened in this world line?

spans.text: I still can't believe this hellscape was the Oasis from before... What on earth happened in this world line?

units.displayText: Okabe, the Oasis was already like this when we came to it in this world line.

spans.text: Okabe, the Oasis was already like this when we came to it in this world line.

units.displayText: ...Entropics?

units.displayText: They're the ones behind all of this. They're a computer virus in this world.

spans.text: They're the ones behind all of this. They're a computer virus in this world.

units.rawText: Okabe... you saw those monsters just now, right?
units.displayText: Okabe... you saw those monsters just now, right?

spans.text: Okabe... you saw those monsters just now, right?

units.rawText: I've been meaning to ask, but what's that little octopus-like guy over here?
units.displayText: I've been meaning to ask, but what's that little octopus-like guy over here?

spans.text: I've been meaning to ask, but what's that little octopus-like guy over here?

units.rawText: That's a diminutive Entropic creature. It's a lifeform unique to the cloud server, a so-called computer virus.
units.displayText: That's a diminutive Entropic creature. It's a lifeform unique to the cloud server, a so-called computer virus.

spans.text: That's a diminutive Entropic creature. It's a lifeform unique to the cloud server, a so-called computer virus.

units.displayText: So that... That's what Entropics really are...

units.displayText: Even now, just recalling the form of that Entropic creature sends chills down my spine.

spans.text: Even now, just recalling the form of that Entropic creature sends chills down my spine.

units.rawText: Have my comrade and the others been fighting scary things like these all this time?

units.displayText: Okabe?

units.rawText: ...I met up with Mayuri outside the Oasis. We encountered the Oasis' field teams on the way back to the Oasis and they escorted us to the Future Gadget Lab.
units.displayText: ...I met up with Mayuri outside the Oasis. We encountered the Oasis' field teams on the way back to the Oasis and they escorted us to the Future Gadget Lab.

spans.text: ...I met up with Mayuri outside the Oasis. We encountered the Oasis' field teams on the way back to the Oasis and they escorted us to the Future Gadget Lab.

units.rawText: That was where we met you.
units.displayText: That was where we met you.

spans.text: That was where we met you.

units.rawText: Was I the only one there? What about my comrade? Were they not in the Lab?
units.displayText: Was I the only one there? What about my comrade? Were they not in the Lab?

spans.text: Was I the only one there? What about my comrade? Were they not in the Lab?

units.rawText: ...We didn't see that comrade of yours, Okabe.
units.displayText: ...We didn't see that comrade of yours, Okabe.

spans.text: ...We didn't see that comrade of yours, Okabe.

units.rawText: I'm guessing that since <cmdr> is the leader of the Oasis, they were probably busy with tackling the Entropic attack before we reached the lab.
units.displayText: I'm guessing that since {교수} is the leader of the Oasis, they were probably busy with tackling the Entropic attack before we reached the lab.

spans.text: I'm guessing that since
is the leader of the Oasis, they were probably busy with tackling the Entropic attack before we reached the lab.

units.rawText: You were still unconscious when we found you. The field team sent us to a nearby shelter to await rescue by the main force, and then you woke up.
units.displayText: You were still unconscious when we found you. The field team sent us to a nearby shelter to await rescue by the main force, and then you woke up.

spans.text: You were still unconscious when we found you. The field team sent us to a nearby shelter to await rescue by the main force, and then you woke up.

units.rawText: A shelter? Then what are we doing here?
units.displayText: A shelter? Then what are we doing here?

spans.text: A shelter? Then what are we doing here?

units.rawText: The girl sighs helplessly.
units.displayText: The girl sighs helplessly.

spans.text: The girl sighs helplessly.

units.rawText: ...You came out here by yourself.
units.displayText: ...You came out here by yourself.

spans.text: You
came out here by yourself.

units.rawText: Why would my past self do anything that dangerous?!
units.displayText: Why would my past self do anything that dangerous?!

spans.text: Why would my past self do anything that dangerous?!

units.rawText: You were looking for someone. The field teams said they picked up Faris' signal near the cafe.
units.displayText: You were looking for someone. The field teams said they picked up Faris' signal near the cafe.

spans.text: You were looking for someone. The field teams said they picked up Faris' signal near the cafe.

units.rawText: Mhm~ When you heard this, you were like a guided missile, Okarin. You just said hi and bye before going "whoosh" out the door.
units.displayText: Mhm~ When you heard this, you were like a guided missile, Okarin. You just said hi and bye before going "whoosh" out the door.

spans.text: Mhm~ When you heard this, you were like a guided missile, Okarin. You just said hi and bye before going "whoosh" out the door.

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: If I'd heard the news now, I'd probably make the same choice.
units.displayText: If I'd heard the news now, I'd probably make the same choice.

spans.text: If I'd heard the news now, I'd probably make the same choice.

units.rawText: ...Although your decisiveness and care for your companions are praiseworthy, your actions lack planning.
units.displayText: ...Although your decisiveness and care for your companions are praiseworthy, your actions lack planning.

spans.text: ...Although your decisiveness and care for your companions are praiseworthy, your actions lack planning.

units.rawText: If Mayuri and I hadn't asked the field team to come out with us, the two of you would probably have ended up surrounded by Entropics.
units.displayText: If Mayuri and I hadn't asked the field team to come out with us, the two of you would probably have ended up surrounded by Entropics.

spans.text: If Mayuri and I hadn't asked the field team to come out with us, the two of you would probably have ended up surrounded by Entropics.

units.rawText: Please don't do something that dangerous again.
units.displayText: Please don't do something that dangerous again.

spans.text: Please don't do something that dangerous again.

units.rawText: ...C-Christina, I can't believe you were so worried about me...
units.displayText: ...C-Christina, I can't believe you were so worried about me...

spans.text: ...C-Christina, I can't believe you were so worried about me...

units.rawText: A look of panic suddenly crosses Kurisu's face.
units.displayText: A look of panic suddenly crosses Kurisu's face.

spans.text: A look of panic suddenly crosses Kurisu's face.

units.rawText: ...I was just worried about Mayuri! That was why I came with her!
units.displayText: ...I was just worried about Mayuri! That was why I came with her!

spans.text: ...I was just worried about Mayuri! That was why I came with her!

units.rawText: Don't get the wrong idea, you dork!
units.displayText: Don't get the wrong idea, you dork!

spans.text: Don't get the wrong idea, you dork!

units.rawText: Oh, okay...
units.displayText: Oh, okay...

spans.text: Oh, okay...

units.rawText: Still, that means Faris ought to be here, right? Where's that catgirl gone?
units.displayText: Still, that means Faris ought to be here, right? Where's that catgirl gone?

spans.text: Still, that means Faris ought to be here, right? Where's that catgirl gone?

units.rawText: A sad look fills their faces as I ask that question.
units.displayText: A sad look fills their faces as I ask that question.

spans.text: A sad look fills their faces as I ask that question.

units.rawText: That's because we got separated from the others...
units.displayText: That's because we got separated from the others...

spans.text: That's because we got separated from the others...

units.rawText: On the way back to the base after finding you, we were attacked by the Entropics.
units.displayText: On the way back to the base after finding you, we were attacked by the Entropics.

spans.text: On the way back to the base after finding you, we were attacked by the Entropics.

units.rawText: Nobody was hurt, but the monsters forced us apart...
units.displayText: Nobody was hurt, but the monsters forced us apart...

spans.text: Nobody was hurt, but the monsters forced us apart...

units.rawText: Faris-san should be fine. The field team is with her, so they should be able to keep her safe.
units.displayText: Faris-san should be fine. The field team is with her, so they should be able to keep her safe.

spans.text: Faris-san should be fine. The field team is with her, so they should be able to keep her safe.

units.rawText: ...We're the ones who're in trouble here.
units.displayText: ...We're the ones who're in trouble here.

spans.text: ...We're the ones who're in trouble here.

units.rawText: Kurisu takes a cell phone-like device from her pocket.
units.displayText: Kurisu takes a cell phone-like device from her pocket.

spans.text: Kurisu takes a cell phone-like device from her pocket.

units.rawText: Its screen has been destroyed, apparently cut by some sharp object.
units.displayText: Its screen has been destroyed, apparently cut by some sharp object.

spans.text: Its screen has been destroyed, apparently cut by some sharp object.

units.rawText: Our communicator was broken while we were fleeing earlier. Right now, all we can do is meet up with the others under our own power.
units.displayText: Our communicator was broken while we were fleeing earlier. Right now, all we can do is meet up with the others under our own power.

spans.text: Our communicator was broken while we were fleeing earlier. Right now, all we can do is meet up with the others under our own power.

units.rawText: Our next move will be...
units.displayText: Our next move will be...

spans.text: Our next move will be...

units.rawText: The roars of the Entropics interrupt her.
units.displayText: The roars of the Entropics interrupt her.

spans.text: The roars of the Entropics interrupt her.

units.rawText: I didn't think they'd find us so quickly... Mayuri, you hide here! Okabe, come to my side, now!
units.displayText: I didn't think they'd find us so quickly... Mayuri, you hide here! Okabe, come to my side, now!

spans.text: I didn't think they'd find us so quickly... Mayuri, you hide here! Okabe, come to my side, now!

units.rawText: Yeah, okay! Stay safe, you two!
units.displayText: Yeah, okay! Stay safe, you two!

spans.text: Yeah, okay! Stay safe, you two!

units.rawText: ...It's there.
units.displayText: ...It's there.

spans.text: ...It's there.

units.rawText: Okabe, look that way! Make sure you don't stick your head out too far, or it'll spot you!
units.displayText: Okabe, look that way! Make sure you don't stick your head out too far, or it'll spot you!

units.displayText: Hssssss—

spans.text: Hssssss—

units.rawText: Isn't... isn't that the Entropic from just now? Did it follow us all the way here?!
units.displayText: Isn't... isn't that the Entropic from just now? Did it follow us all the way here?!

spans.text: Isn't... isn't that the Entropic from just now? Did it follow us all the way here?!

units.displayText: Looks like it's got its eye on us.

units.rawText: I look around our ruined surroundings. The burning Oasis, the shifts between world lines, these scary monsters...
units.displayText: I look around our ruined surroundings. The burning Oasis, the shifts between world lines, these scary monsters...

spans.text: I look around our ruined surroundings. The burning Oasis, the shifts between world lines, these scary monsters...
